dependency: Task 202 runner output, port 8012 thirty-six-row proof and GitHub remote readback must exist before any Task 204 automation or queue contract is created.
geometry_policy: No new coordinates, polygons, building footprints or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Every selected row remains NOT_BOUND.

features.name: 80 Fenchurch Street
features.official_source_evidence: The named building domain is retained as the primary source target. Current authoritative building records identify 80 Fenchurch Street as a City of London commercial office building, while the previously stored domain requires renewed remote readback.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is supported, but the current official building page must be revalidated and the exact named-building footprint must be isolated before binding.

features.name: Prologis Park Midpoint
features.official_source_evidence: Prologis is the authoritative logistics-property operator and the named Midpoint location is an industrial and distribution park containing multiple warehouse units.
features.classification_finding: Industrial use is supported, but the whole park cannot be treated as one Industrial Unit. A current official property path and one named warehouse or defensible parcel are required.

features.name: Prologis Park Hemel Hempstead
features.official_source_evidence: Prologis is the authoritative logistics-property operator and the Hemel Hempstead park identity represents a multi-unit industrial and distribution location.
features.classification_finding: Industrial use is supported, but park-level evidence is insufficient for one Industrial Unit. A named warehouse unit or exact industrial parcel must be selected.

features.name: 25 Churchill Place
features.official_source_evidence: Canary Wharf development and architectural records identify 25 Churchill Place as a completed office tower with Grade A office accommodation at the named Canary Wharf address.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is strongly supported. The legacy named domain and current owner or occupier property page require remote revalidation before exact footprint binding.

features.name: One Nine Elms
features.official_source_evidence: KPF's authoritative project page identifies One Nine Elms as a completed two-tower development containing homes and hospitality uses.
features.classification_finding: Residential use is substantial, but the tracked entity contains two towers and non-residential hospitality components. A specific residential tower or exact parcel is required before retaining Apartment Building and binding geometry.

features.name: Thames City
features.official_source_evidence: The official Thames City site presents a large Nine Elms residential development containing multiple towers, apartments and associated amenities.
features.classification_finding: Residential use is authoritative, but Thames City is a multi-building development rather than one Apartment Building. A named completed tower or exact parcel must be selected.

features.name: The Stage Shoreditch
features.official_source_evidence: The named development site and authoritative project records describe a residential tower together with substantial office, retail, leisure, public-realm and heritage components.
features.classification_finding: The residential tower can support Apartment Building only when isolated from the wider mixed-use development. The complete Stage scheme is not one apartment building.

features.name: Dunham Massey
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Dunham Massey as a historic house with gardens, deer park and a wider estate in Greater Manchester.
features.classification_finding: The principal house identity is authoritative, but the tracked visitor property includes extensive park and estate land. The main house must be isolated and Detached Home taxonomy reviewed against heritage use.

features.name: Belton House
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Belton House as a historic mansion with gardens, parkland and a wider visitor estate near Grantham.
features.classification_finding: The main house identity is authoritative, but the visitor property includes parkland and estate functions. The principal mansion footprint must be isolated and residential Detached Home taxonomy reviewed.

features.name: Attingham Park
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Attingham Park as a historic mansion, gardens and extensive Shropshire estate.
features.classification_finding: The mansion is authoritative, but the named property includes extensive estate land and visitor functions. The main hall must be isolated and Detached Home taxonomy reviewed.

features.name: DAMAC Tower Nine Elms
features.official_source_evidence: DAMAC is the primary developer source and identifies the completed Nine Elms tower development and its residential apartments.
features.classification_finding: Apartment Building is strongly supported for the principal residential tower, but connected lower-rise and non-residential components require the exact residential footprint to be isolated.

features.name: One West Point
features.official_source_evidence: The named development site and authoritative building records identify One West Point as a completed residential high-rise development in North Acton containing multiple towers.
features.classification_finding: Residential use is supported, but One West Point is a four-tower development rather than one Apartment Building. A named tower or exact parcel must be selected before binding.
